shadows.name: control
shadows.purpose: Distinguishes the selected language on web.

components.name: Selected language
components.css: .ds-locale-selected { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding-inline: 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--vetx-color-control, #e3eae2); color: var(--vetx-color-ink, #182f29); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px #0d24171a; font: 600 14px 'Instrument Sans Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-locale-selected:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--vetx-color-focus, #266750); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Alternate language
components.css: .ds-locale-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding-inline: 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--vetx-color-muted, #4b6159); font: 600 14px 'Instrument Sans Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-locale-ghost:hover { background: var(--vetx-color-control, #e3eae2); color: var(--vetx-color-ink, #182f29); } .ds-locale-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--vetx-color-focus, #266750); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Service readiness
components.description: Pairs a state color with a localized service status.
components.css: .ds-service-status { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; color: var(--vetx-color-muted, #4b6159); font: 400 14px 'Instrument Sans Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-service-dot { flex: 0 0 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--vetx-color-positive, #236148); }

narrative.overview: The clinical folder is the visual reference. Soft paper tones make text easy to find and read. A single deep-green field carries the crossed-stroke VetX mark.
